note: Worker authentication: session tokens and nonce-bound challenge responses are MACed with HmacSha256 over the canonical claims (session, worker, expires, nonce) and compared in constant time. Inspected src/worker/auth.zig: an edited token fails the MAC check rather than being re-scoped, a genuine foreign-session token fails the binding check before any work, and artifact requests are checked against a per-session scope so session A cannot reach session B's artifacts. Fault evidence confirms the check is load-bearing: skipping the comparison makes the case fail (exit 1), and the revert was byte-identical (verified with diff). Portable case, recorded on windows-x86_64.
authority: self-reported local review, not independent attestation
